name: כופלי לגרנז' – נפח מקסימלי של תיבה מתחת למישור (באנגלית)
questiontext:
Find the volume of the largest rectangular box in the first octant with three faces in the coordinate planes and one vertex on the plane \( {{CT:0}}x+{{CT:1}}y+{{CT:2}}z={{CT:3}} \)

[[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]]

on_true.feedback:
Incorrect answer!

 

Since the rectangular box is in the first octant with three faces in the coordinate planes, the volume is calculated by the function \(V(x,y,z)=xyz\).

In order to satisfy of the restriction we substitute \( z={{CT:4}} \), which guarantees that one vertex is on the plane \({{CT:0}}x+{{CT:1}}y+{{CT:2}}z={{CT:3}}\) and we get the function \(V(x,y)=xy{{CT:4}}\).

Notice: The plane \( {{CT:0}}x+{{CT:1}}y+{{CT:2}}z={{CT:3}} \) has points on the first octant which are not on the coordinate planes. Therefore there's a point such that the volume of the rectangular is strictly greater than \(0\).

After calculating the system \( \left\{\begin{array}{cc}\frac{\partial V}{\partial x}(x,y)=0 \\\frac{\partial V}{\partial y}(x,y)=0 \end{array}\right. \) we get the critical points:

{{CT:5}}

Notice that only one point gives a volume which is strictly greater than \(0\). We get \(z={{CT:6}}\) and the correct answer is {{CT:7}}.
